summary: Resolve the Granola sync robustness, read-path diagnostics, and agent-surface drift tracked in public issues 1600 through 1602.
reason: The curated Granola CLI still allowed cancellation-insensitive API requests, discarded fetched notes after late failures, ran unbounded auto-refresh paging, raced additive schema DDL, rebuilt full-text indexes on every sync, treated an empty failed-sync schema as usable, hid corrupt-store errors, relied on stale doctor state, advertised invalid MCP paging, emitted incompatible warning shapes, omitted transcript source values, and retained notes removed upstream.
validated_outcome: Regression tests cover in-flight cancellation, partial-progress persistence, bounded paging, concurrent first-open schema migration, incremental FTS maintenance, successful-empty versus never-synced stores, corrupt-store propagation, live migrated-scheme diagnosis, full-sync deletion reconciliation, MCP paging guidance, warning arrays, and transcript source documentation.
